objectives.text: Read a ratio as equal parts of one whole: 2:3 as 2 parts and 3 parts of the same whole
successCriteria: I can say that 2:3 means 2 parts and 3 parts of the same whole
I can show the whole split into 5 equal parts
assessmentPoints: Parts answers in the opening activity
Responses when the trap is sprung in the second activity

objectives.text: Share an amount in a ratio by finding one part first: divide the whole by the total number of parts
successCriteria: I can find one part by dividing $48 by 5
I can work out both shares as $19.20 and $28.80
assessmentPoints: Guided one-part answers in the third activity
Worksheet answers in the closing practice

activities.title: Sharing in a ratio: split $48 into 2 parts and 3 parts
One part, then multiply: sharing $48 in 2:3

differentiation.support: Provide a bar split into five equal parts so one part can be seen before it is calculated.

activities.title: Land the add, divide, multiply rule

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to share $60 in the ratio 2:3 using the same one-part method.
